# FineArt Pro Tattoo — Roman Olichowski, Tattoo Artist in Limassol, Cyprus

> FineArt Pro Tattoo is the private tattoo studio of Roman Olichowski in Limassol, Cyprus. Roman specialises in fine line tattoos, microrealism, fine-line lettering and custom concept / fine art tattoos, including designs inspired by Greek statues and Stoic philosophy (Greek gods, Marcus Aurelius, Prometheus, Icarus, Michelangelo's David). Appointments and same-day walk-in slots via WhatsApp; clients also travel in from Paphos, Larnaca and Nicosia. Roman speaks Russian fluently and consults in English, Russian and German. He also runs a live tattoo station for weddings, parties and corporate events across Cyprus. Before tattooing, Roman worked as a glass painter and art glazier (stained glass) at Derix. He has six years of full-time professional tattooing experience. Guest spots outside Cyprus are by arrangement.

## Key facts
- Artist: Roman Olichowski (brand: FineArt Pro Tattoo)
- Main location: private studio in Limassol, Cyprus (exact address shared with the confirmed time)
- Walk-ins: yes, via WhatsApp — message first; same-day slots when free, best for small fine line tattoos and lettering
- Events: tattoo station for weddings, birthdays, tattoo parties, yacht and corporate events across Cyprus (Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Nicosia, Ayia Napa, Protaras); packages on request
- Service area: Limassol (incl. Germasogeia, Agios Tychonas, Mesa Geitonia, Old Town, Marina), Paphos (~50 min), Larnaca (~45–50 min), Nicosia (~1 h), visitors to Cyprus
- Guest work outside Cyprus is by arrangement. The regular tattoo appointments listed here take place in Limassol.
- Styles: fine line tattoos, microrealism (black and grey), concept tattoos, fine art tattoos, Greek statue and Stoic tattoo designs, meaningful and philosophical tattoos (memento mori, amor fati, Marcus Aurelius, Icarus, Prometheus), fine-line lettering, small / mini tattoos, matching tattoos, cover-ups and reworks on request
- Languages: Russian (fluent), English, German — a Russian- and German-speaking tattoo artist in Limassol
- Minimum age at FineArt Pro Tattoo: 18 (ID required)
- Pricing: individual quote based on size, detail and placement
- Booking: WhatsApp +49 179 1518975, Instagram @fineartprotattoo, email fineartprotattoo@gmail.com
